newsitem.title: CHINA: China Shipping Group to start operations in July.
newsitem.headline: China Shipping Group to start operations in July.

text.p: Newly established China Shipping Group Co, the result of a merger of a number of China's biggest shipping companies, will start operations in July, the Shanghai Securities News said on Tuesday.
The group, based in Shanghai, was the result of the merger of Shanghai Shipping Group Co, Guangdong Shipping Group Co, Dalian Shipping Group Co and two other minor shipping firms, the newspaper said.
It has a fleet of 431 ships, with a capacity of 8.367 million tonnes and total assets of 25.1 billion yuan, it said.
Setting up the shipping giant conformed with China's efforts to create industrial conglomerates to improve the competitiveness of state enterprises, the newspaper said.
The new company also has controlling shares in Hong Kong-listed Shanghai Hai Xing Shipping Co and Shanghai-listed Hainan Haisheng Shipping Co, the newspaper said.
